items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and continue existing finance reconciliation work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a. Do not authorize new production work, requeues, spending, monetization changes, or forecasts. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; $0 is site-attributed and the $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 totals $922.38102435 across 5,048 calls and 39 instrumented sites. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, AI payback, infrastructure burden, budget exposure, and forecast are unknown because matching-period revenue identifiers, complete cost ledgers, infrastructure costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved learning threshold are absent. Minimum artifact: dated reconciliation of 18 named tracking rows plus the aggregate row against matching-period revenue, AI spend, infrastructure spend, other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and the learning threshold. Treat SEO totals and conversion counts as operating indicators, not financial proof.

Reject vanity-metric and unsupported forecast claims. The 30-day scorecard has 3 proven outcomes and 41 improvements awaiting measurement; SEO reports 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions. These figures do not establish revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, or causal lift.

Continue the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve the aggregate provider commission as unattributed; do not claim site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, forecast, or causal lift. Missing costs, commitments, budgets, and learning thresholds remain unknown.
